answerSnapshotReview.method: Manually inspected both complete answer bodies (prose and code) and revision metadata from the cached Stack Exchange withbody responses. Reproduced the historical canonical revision-projection and UTF-8 body hashes before inspection. Null notice fields mean none supplied in those bodies, not a claim about other revisions, linked works or the complete website. Raw-response hashes additionally bind user display metadata and revision comments excluded by the historical projection. Bodies remain retrievable from the technicalSources URLs in the scoped review; no full answer bodies are committed here.

observations.revisionComment: Refresh code with version employing more accurate core approximations (max ulp error reduced slightly, average error reduced more significantly). Adjustments in the textual description to match the new code plus minor wordsmithing.

answerSnapshotReview.answerRevisionNotesAndMlxModifications: The candidate notice summarizes the licensor's own answer revision comments as revision notes and separately describes the visible downstream MLX modifications. The author's edits to his own answer are not labeled prior downstream modifications. No additional attribution designation, copyright notice or warranty-disclaimer notice was supplied in either reviewed answer body. This observation does not determine legal sufficiency or close the owner review.
